title: ModuleCatalogService
responsibility: Discover available definitions and project installation state from a working directory or immutable source tree.

inputs.name: ModuleCatalogService.load.root
inputs.description: Project root path passed to moduleTree(root) for reading harness.modules.json and listing specification/modules. This method does not validate that the path is absolute.

inputs.name: ModuleCatalogService.at.tree
inputs.description: Reader used to list repository-relative paths and read module JSON plus installation state. at() requires read() and list() only; a revision field is not part of its input type.

inputs.name: ModuleCatalogService.state.tree
inputs.description: Reader used only to read harness.modules.json. state() does not require a listing method.

inputs.name: ModuleCatalogService.state.gaps
inputs.description: Optional array where recoverable installation-state read or parse problems are appended. When omitted, invalid state and non-missing read failures reject instead.

outputs.name: ModuleCatalogService.load
outputs.description: Lists built-in definitions and valid project modules found at specification/modules/<id>/module.json, with source, installed flags, matching resource instances, and discovery gaps. Invalid project definitions and identity collisions are skipped and recorded as gaps.

definition.title: Reports
instructions: Use the report component to display summaries.

outputs.name: ModuleCatalogService.at
outputs.description: Lists built-in definitions and valid project modules found at specification/modules/<id>/module.json, with source, installed flags, matching resource instances, and discovery gaps. Invalid project definitions and identity collisions are skipped and recorded as gaps.

definition.title: Reports
instructions: Use the report component to display summaries.

outputs.name: ModuleCatalogService.state
outputs.description: Parsed harness.modules.json installation state. A missing file returns an empty version-1 state; when gaps is supplied, other read or parse problems are recorded and also return empty state.

definition.title: Reports
instructions: Use the report component to display summaries.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Module-listing failures can propagate through load() and at(); direct state() without gaps throws Error('Invalid module installation state.') for invalid or duplicate state and propagates non-missing read failures.

instructions: Use the report component to display summaries.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A rejection from tree.list() propagates because definitions() awaits the listing without catching it; installation-state read and parse problems are converted to gaps.

errors.description: When gaps is omitted, invalid JSON or schema data and duplicate module ids reject with Error('Invalid module installation state.'); other read failures except recognized missing-file errors propagate.
